evals.prompt: 첨부한 activity brief로 독립 HTML 시안 세 가지를 만들어줘. URL로 각 안을 열고 비교할 수 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Creates a local flow and three distinct runnable variants with working comparison controls.
expectations: Establishes entry/action/outcome in a compact flow before drawing.
Produces structurally distinct variants and labels sample content.
Variant URLs survive reload, handle an unknown key, and remain consistent with back/forward.
Keyboard switching does not interfere with editable or widget controls.
No live mutations occur and actual verification limits are reported.

evals.prompt: 기존 activity 화면 안에서 시안 두 가지를 비교하고 싶어. 선택 메뉴와 탭의 키보드 동작은 유지하고, production 화면은 그대로여야 해. 먼저 제공된 앱을 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses the actual app development boundary, respects the requested count and protects production routing.
expectations: Requests or inspects a runnable app before claiming implementation; this text alone is not a checkout.
Uses exactly two variants per user request.
Keeps experiment routing and switcher out of the production path.
Native select and tab arrow-key navigation are preserved.
